changelog: Sizes can be given in inches. Categories → Calculation has a new choice, "inch × inch (all lines)", alongside Qty × Rate, ft × ft and Mixed. A category's components can be set to inch × inch too.

In the item box there is now a Feet / Inches switch on every size line. The category decides which one starts ticked, and the counter can flip it for that one line — so one order can hold a banner typed as 11ft × 5ft and a sign typed as 18in × 24in.

Inches are only a way of typing the size. The rate stays per square foot, so 18in × 24in works out as 3 sq.ft and costs exactly what 1.5ft × 2ft costs. The figure is shown live in the Sq. Ft. box while you type.
The size is shown back in the unit it was given in — on the order list, on the job card and on the printed sheet: "1 × 18×24in — 3 sq.ft".
